title: A Diagram with No Labels
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。人物、出来事は架空の例。実在の調査、実証結果、制度、個別医療の助言ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A science teacher asks her students to draw a diagram of a process they have studied.
sentences.ja: 理科教師は学んだ過程の図を描くよう生徒に頼む。

sentences.en: Most students produce careful drawings that look similar to the illustration in their textbook.
sentences.ja: 多くの生徒が教科書の図に似た丁寧な絵を作る。

sentences.en: They copy the labels accurately and use arrows to connect different parts.
sentences.ja: ラベルを正確に写し矢印で異なる部分を結ぶ。

sentences.en: The teacher is pleased with their work, but she wonders whether they understand the connections.
sentences.ja: 教師は作品に満足するがつながりを理解しているか疑問を持つ。

sentences.en: The following day, she gives them a diagram without any labels.
sentences.ja: 翌日、ラベルのない図を渡す。

sentences.en: She asks the students to explain what each arrow represents before writing any technical terms.
sentences.ja: 専門用語を書く前に各矢印が何を表すか説明するよう求める。

sentences.en: Some students remember the names of the parts but have difficulty describing the relationships between them.
sentences.ja: 部分の名前を覚えていても関係を記述するのに苦労する生徒もいる。

sentences.en: Others can explain the process in ordinary language even when they cannot recall the exact vocabulary.
sentences.ja: 正確な語彙を思い出せなくても普通の言葉で過程を説明できる生徒もいる。

sentences.en: The teacher decides to provide a different kind of feedback to each group.
sentences.ja: 教師は各集団に異なる種類の助言を提供することにする。

sentences.en: Students who know the terms practice explaining the function of each connection.
sentences.ja: 用語を知る生徒は各つながりの機能を説明する練習をする。

sentences.en: Those who understand the relationships review the vocabulary necessary for communicating their ideas precisely.
sentences.ja: 関係を理解する生徒は考えを正確に伝えるため必要な語彙を復習する。

sentences.en: Both groups return to the original illustration after attempting these activities independently.
sentences.ja: 両集団は活動を独力で試みた後元の図に戻る。

sentences.en: Later, the students create their own diagrams for a different example of the same general process.
sentences.ja: 後で同じ一般過程の別例について独自の図を作る。

sentences.en: They compare their explanations and discuss why a particular connection is necessary.
sentences.ja: 説明を比較し特定のつながりがなぜ必要か議論する。

sentences.en: The activity does not guarantee that every student will understand every scientific concept.
sentences.ja: 活動は全生徒が全科学概念を理解することを保証しない。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, it gives the teacher more information about what students can actually explain.
sentences.ja: それでも生徒が実際に何を説明できるかについて教師により多くの情報を与える。

sentences.en: A successful drawing may demonstrate several useful abilities at once.
sentences.ja: 成功した図は複数の有用能力を一度に示し得る。

sentences.en: However, copying an accurate illustration is not necessarily the same as understanding its meaning.
sentences.ja: しかし正確な図を写すことは必ずしも意味の理解と同じではない。

sentences.en: Learning becomes more effective when students recognize which aspects of a task they have mastered and which require further practice.
sentences.ja: 課題の習得した側面と追加練習が必要な側面を認識すると学習はより効果的になる。

sentences.en: The missing labels help make those differences visible.
sentences.ja: 欠けたラベルはその違いを可視化する助けとなる。

Whether the students have a textbook.

Everyone has exactly the same difficulty.

questions.prompt: What do students who understand relationships review?
options: The vocabulary needed to explain ideas precisely.

questions.prompt: Why provide different kinds of feedback?
options: Every student must do the same task first.
The teacher wants students to avoid the original illustration.
A new textbook for every subject.
Diagrams of a different example of the process.
Copies of the first illustration only.

questions.prompt: What does the activity help the teacher find out?
options: Which student can draw most beautifully.
The exact result of every future test.
Whether all concepts are permanently mastered.
Copying a diagram always proves complete understanding.
Scientific vocabulary should never be taught.
